ctas.audience: Immigrants searching for a USCIS field office in their state or city, who need an I-693 medical exam from a USCIS-designated civil surgeon.
ctas.heading: Looking for the USCIS field office in %%STATE%%? Your medical exam is not done there
ctas.body: USCIS field offices hold interviews and biometrics, but they do not do the immigration medical exam. Form I-693 must be completed by a USCIS-designated civil surgeon, a private doctor you book yourself, and the sealed form goes in with your application or to your interview. Find a civil surgeon near you in %%STATE%% before your interview date.
ctas.field_office_label: Find your USCIS field office (official locator)
ctas.finder_label: Find a civil surgeon (official USCIS finder)
ctas.cta_label: Get matched with a civil surgeon in %%STATE%%
